subject: Remove unnecessary clang-format off annotations (#628)
reason: The change (#628) removes clang-format off/on comment annotations and reformats the enclosed code (spacing after commas, switch indentation, splitting fall-through case labels onto separate lines). Every hunk alters only whitespace, line breaks and comments; all expressions, case labels, flag computations and return values are token-identical before and after. It is a pure formatting refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario can distinguish the builds and none is needed.
